translations.web: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
translations.bsb: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs
translations.asv: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover the flesh of their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
